disease_label_per_paper: Recurrent Nocardial Brain Abscess Developing in an Immunocompetent Patient, A Case Report
presentation_summary: Immunocompetent woman presented with 10 days of worsening headache and 3 days of nausea and vomiting.
Admission temperature was 36 C with WBC 10.0 x10^9/L, neutrophils 8.75 x10^9/L, hemoglobin 12 g/dL, platelets 342 x10^9/L, CRP 33 mg/L, and procalcitonin 0.05 ng/mL.
Three months earlier, PET/CT showed a right suprahilar lung mass and right frontal brain lesion; current MRI showed a right frontal ring-enhancing brain abscess measuring 47 x 37 mm.
The abscess recurred repeatedly; final surgery showed gram-positive branching acid-resistant bacilli and culture grew Nocardia spp. with TMP-SMX resistance.
